comment: Cornerman drop-worker repo profile registry. Deploy the live copy to C:\lifepunch\cornerman\config\repo-profiles.json on Green. The worker fails closed if a packet's repoProfile is not found here, if the clone path is missing, or if the clone's git remotes do not match expectedRemotes.

branchLaw.note: main = clean truth/export/stability (Green default). develop only when the packet explicitly targets active work / current testing / develop-bound audits.
Base is always upstream/develop. Reviewing an existing PR branch requires an explicit reviewBranch in the packet. The worker never creates, checks out, or pushes branches.
